def factor_market_cycle_ewm_overnight_intraday(df):
    """Market cycle phase from exponentially weighted overnight-intraday return split."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    span = 60
    overnight_ewm_sum = overnight_ret.ewm(span=span, adjust=True).sum()
    intraday_ewm_sum = intraday_ret.ewm(span=span, adjust=True).sum()
    overnight_abs_ewm_sum = overnight_ret.abs().ewm(span=span, adjust=True).sum()
    intraday_abs_ewm_sum = intraday_ret.abs().ewm(span=span, adjust=True).sum()
    numerator = overnight_ewm_sum - intraday_ewm_sum
    denominator = (overnight_abs_ewm_sum + intraday_abs_ewm_sum).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    cycle = (numerator / denominator).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_market_cycle_ewm_overnight_intraday"] = cycle
    return df_copy["factor_market_cycle_ewm_overnight_intraday"]
description: Mutation of parent alpha-market-cycle-0-2. Preserves the overnight-intraday split mechanism and total absolute normalization, but replaces the trailing 120-day equal-weight cumulative sum with an exponentially weighted moving sum (span 60) to better capture recent market cycle shifts. This is a small smoothing/window change targeting improved responsiveness while preserving parent payoff-thickness and stability strengths. Parent strength target: high long_short_sharpe, monotonicity, and ICIR/RankICIR stability. Repaired to use adjust=True in ewm sum calls.
